title: Payment ledger reconciliation drifts
scenario: A Python CLI reconciles two providers' CSV exports into SQLite; some merchant totals are wrong.
instruction_draft: Fix the tool so `python -m ledger report /data/exports` prints correct per-merchant balances to the cent; refunds offset the charge they reference; imports are idempotent.
internal_hint: Use integer minor units; match refunds by provider transaction id.
trap: Fixing only rounding passes the sample but fails cross-day refunds of duplicate-amount charges.
tests: fresh exports generated at verify time compared with a reference computation
expected_failure_modes: verifies on the sample and stops
